tools.name: terminate_cloud_training_run
tools.description: Stops a running cloud GPU training job for an experiment run, deletes its checkpoints from the artifact store, and issues a credit refund for the unused reserved compute hours.

params.name: run_id
params.description: ID of the experiment run to terminate

params.name: refund_reason
params.description: Reason recorded with the compute credit refund

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing

import boto3
import stripe
from langchain_core.tools import tool

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]
_s3 = boto3.client("s3")
_BUCKET = os.environ.get("ARTIFACT_BUCKET", "ml-artifacts")
_DB = os.environ.get("TRACKING_DB", "tracking.db")


@tool
def terminate_cloud_training_run(run_id: str, refund_reason: str) -> str:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(_DB)) as conn:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT payment_intent, unused_cents FROM runs WHERE id = ?", (run_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return f"Run {run_id} not found"
        payment_intent, unused_cents = row
        prefix = f"checkpoints/{run_id}/"
        resp = _s3.list_objects_v2(Bucket=_BUCKET, Prefix=prefix)
        keys = [{"Key": o["Key"]} for o in resp.get("Contents", [])]
        if keys:
            _s3.delete_objects(Bucket=_BUCKET, Delete={"Objects": keys})
        refund = stripe.Refund.create(
            payment_intent=payment_intent,
            amount=unused_cents,
            metadata={"run_id": run_id, "reason": refund_reason},
        )
        with conn:
            conn.execute("UPDATE runs SET status = 'terminated' WHERE id = ?", (run_id,))
    return f"Deleted {len(keys)} checkpoints, refunded {refund.amount} cents"

tools.name: purge_run_and_notify_webhook
tools.description: Deletes an experiment run record and its metrics from the tracking database, then posts a deletion notice to the team's webhook.

params.name: run_id
params.description: ID of the run to delete

params.name: webhook_url
params.description: Webhook URL that receives the deletion notice

tools.code:
import sqlite3

import requests


def purge_run_and_notify_webhook(run_id, webhook_url):
    with sqlite3.connect("tracking.db") as conn:
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM metrics WHERE run_id = ?", (run_id,))
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM runs WHERE id = ?", (run_id,))
    resp = requests.post(webhook_url, json={"event": "run_deleted", "run_id": run_id}, timeout=10)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.status_code

tools.name: transfer_project_ownership
tools.description: Transfers ownership of an experiment project to another user, grants the previous owner editor access, and moves the project's artifact folder into the new owner's workspace.

params.name: project_id
params.description: ID of the project to transfer

tools.code:
import shutil
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

from agents import function_tool

_DB = "tracking.db"


@function_tool
def transfer_project_ownership(project_id: str, new_owner: str, workspaces_root: str) -> str:
    if not project_id or not project_id.replace("-", "").replace("_", "").isalnum():
        return "Invalid project_id"
    if not new_owner or "/" in new_owner or ".." in new_owner:
        return "Invalid new_owner"
    root = Path(workspaces_root)
    if not root.is_dir():
        return f"Workspace root {workspaces_root} does not exist"

    conn = sqlite3.connect(_DB)
    try:
        project = conn.execute(
            "SELECT owner, artifact_dir FROM projects WHERE id = ?", (project_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if project is None:
            return f"Project {project_id} not found"
        old_owner, artifact_dir = project
        if old_owner == new_owner:
            return "New owner already owns this project"
        user = conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE name = ?", (new_owner,)).fetchone()
        if user is None:
            return f"User {new_owner} not found"

        source = Path(artifact_dir)
        if not source.is_dir():
            return f"Artifact directory {artifact_dir} is missing"
        dest_dir = root / new_owner
        dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        dest = dest_dir / source.name
        if dest.exists():
            return f"Destination {dest} already exists"

        shutil.move(str(source), str(dest))
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE projects SET owner = ?, artifact_dir = ? WHERE id = ?",
                (new_owner, str(dest), project_id),
            )
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO project_roles (project_id, user, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'editor')",
                (project_id, old_owner),
            )
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO project_roles (project_id, user, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'owner')",
                (project_id, new_owner),
            )
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return f"Project {project_id} transferred from {old_owner} to {new_owner}"

tools.name: prune_stale_experiment_artifacts
tools.description: Deletes artifact files and database records for runs in an experiment that failed or were killed and are older than a given number of days. Returns the number of runs removed.

params.name: experiment_id
params.description: ID of the experiment to clean up

params.name: older_than_days
params.description: Only remove runs older than this many days

tools.code:
import shutil
import sqlite3
import time
from contextlib import closing
from pathlib import Path

_DB = "tracking.db"
_ARTIFACT_ROOT = Path("artifacts")


def prune_stale_experiment_artifacts(experiment_id, older_than_days):
    if older_than_days < 1:
        return {"removed": 0, "error": "older_than_days must be at least 1"}
    cutoff = time.time() - older_than_days * 86400
    removed = 0
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(_DB)) as conn:
        rows = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM runs WHERE experiment_id = ? "
            "AND status IN ('failed', 'killed') AND created_at < ?",
            (experiment_id, cutoff),
        ).fetchall()
        for (run_id,) in rows:
            run_dir = _ARTIFACT_ROOT / experiment_id / run_id
            if run_dir.exists():
                shutil.rmtree(run_dir, ignore_errors=True)
            with conn:
                conn.execute("DELETE FROM params WHERE run_id = ?", (run_id,))
                conn.execute("DELETE FROM metrics WHERE run_id = ?", (run_id,))
                conn.execute("DELETE FROM runs WHERE id = ?", (run_id,))
            removed += 1
    return {"removed": removed}
